messages:
Alejandra C: planning a small console UI deploy at 2026-03-17T15:30PT. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/482 includes a tiny CSS tweak + asset-hash change. Need a quick smoke and CDN invalidation plan. Who can partner on smoke and rollback?

Samir K: I can handle CDN invalidation. What's the cache TTL on /static/*? If we invalidate, are we doing a full purge or targeted by hash?

Luc S: Oncall note — prefer targeted invalidation by asset hash + short edge TTL bump. Avoid full purge during business hours. Confirm origin headers: S3 currently sets Cache-Control: max-age=86400.

Jia H: I can run the smoke checklist once canary is up. Share the checklist please. I will test login, workspace nav, model list, and the inference console load.

Alejandra C: Quick checklist: 1) Canary at 2% -> confirm index.html points to new hash; 2) Login + profile flow; 3) Run sample prompt UI; 4) Search + model details; 5) No 404s for bundles. Build/deploy notes:
```
npm ci && npm run build:prod
aws s3 cp dist/ s3://redwood-console-statics/ --recursive --cache-control 'max-age=31536000,public'
```
To verify asset version: open /index.html and look for `app.[hash].js`.

Samir K: I'll schedule targeted invalidation for `app.*.js` and `vendor.*.js`. Also pre-warm edges with a tiny curl loop after canary: 
```
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -sSf https://console.redwood.ai/ > /dev/null; done
```
I'll kick that post-canary.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: frontend-console v2026.03.17-482 starting canary on cdn-edge slot canary-7 at 15:30PT — monitor: https://deploys.internal/redwood/1779991234

Jia H: Canary smoke quick pass: login OK, model list loads, sample prompt returns. Noticed slight layout shift on Safari iOS header (logo overlap) — capturing screenshot and uploading to QA board.

Lucas R: Rollback plan ready: previous stable tag v2026.03.16-470. If needed, we promote that tag and invalidate the new hashes. I have the rollback commands staged and will execute on call.

Alejandra C: Thanks everyone. Hold canary for 10m while we watch metrics. If no regressions -> promote. @Samir K please do the targeted invalidation + pre-warm after 2% canary starts.

Samir K: :thumbsup: Will do. Starting pre-warm after canary ping.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 2% traffic @ 15:31PT. canary-id: c-7a9b

Jia H: Smoke update @15:34PT: main flows pass, Safari glitch confirmed but non-blocking. Recommend promote. Logged issue #548 in QA board with screenshot.

Alejandra C: Promote in 3m unless we see anything else. Tagging @Lucas R to standby for rollback. :rocket:

Lucas R: :ok_hand: Standing by.
